caption: A car's side mirror is adjusted from inside, and the view in the mirror sweeps from the sky down to the road behind.

sa.check: A car's side mirror is adjusted from inside.
The view in the mirror sweeps from the sky down to the road behind.
The view stops changing when the adjustment stops.
The mirror shows the scene behind the car.

pc.expect: The view moves smoothly as the mirror tilts and shows the scene behind the car, not in front.
pc.fail: It stays fixed as the mirror tilts; or it shows the road ahead; or it jumps.

pc.expect: The view changes only while the mirror moves and stops when the adjustment stops.
pc.fail: It sweeps with the mirror still; or keeps moving after the adjustment stops; or changes before it.
Lettering reads the right way round; or the scene is not mirrored; or it is upside down.

pc.expect: The mirror is rigid: the view is undistorted.
pc.fail: It ripples; or warps; or bends.
The mirror duplicates or vanishes; or the reflection becomes solid; or the mirror passes through the door.

pc.expect: The car and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The car changes colour; or the mirror housing changes; or the surroundings rearrange.
